title: external_integration_test is occasionally flaky

labels.name: P3
labels.description: We're not considering working on this, but happy to review a PR. (No assignee)

body:
I saw `test_moving_build_file` in `external_integration_test` fail once. All the other tests cases passed, and that one passed on the next try.

I've only seen this once in many runs of the tests, so it doesn't seem to happen very often. Seems like a pretty low priority to fix, but good to keep track of.

Here's the output:

```
** test_moving_build_file ******************************************************
-- Test log: -----------------------------------------------------------
INFO: Reading 'startup' options from /home/brian/.cache/bazel/_bazel_brian/64fd1c20dfa33e2ee5e3137540b800c3/bazel/_tmp/external_integration_test_47/bazelrc: --output_user_root=/home/brian/.cache/bazel/_bazel_brian/64fd1c20dfa33e2ee5e3137540b800c3/bazel/_tmp/external_integration_test_47/root --host_javabase=/home/brian/.cache/bazel/_bazel_brian/64fd1c20dfa33e2ee5e3137540b800c3/bazel/bazel-out/local_linux-fastbuild/bin/src/test/shell/bazel/external_integration_test.runfiles/external/local_jdk

ERROR: no such package '@x//': Error downloading from http://localhost:34128/x.tar.gz to /home/brian/.cache/bazel/_bazel_brian/64fd1c20dfa33e2ee5e3137540b800c3/bazel/_tmp/external_integration_test_47/root/f2c26ba36a15ade31e9a3d77b34abecc/external/x: Error downloading http://localhost:34128/x.tar.gz to /home/brian/.cache/bazel/_bazel_brian/64fd1c20dfa33e2ee5e3137540b800c3/bazel/_tmp/external_integration_test_47/root/f2c26ba36a15ade31e9a3d77b34abecc/external/x/x.tar.gz: Connection refused.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_moving_build_file FAILED: Build 2 failed.
src/test/shell/bazel/external_integration_test:721: in call to test_moving_build_file
FAILED: test_moving_build_file
```

Looking through the test code, I don't see anything which ensures the `nc` instance `serve_file` in `remote_helpers.sh` starts has bound to the port before the test continues. That seems likely to create this situation.
